name: ReEvo-designed memetic algorithm for secure fluid antenna systems
one_liner: An LLM evolves crossover, mutation and local-search operators offline against a wireless simulation, and the finished algorithm runs without any LLM.

loop.proposes: Crossover, mutation and local-search operator code for fluid antenna port selection, written by DeepSeek Reasoner
loop.judged_by: Best secure sum-rate an inner genetic algorithm reaches with the operators on training channels, via secure WMMSE
loop.steers: ReEvo's reflective evolution feeds performance comparisons back into the next round of operator code

headline_result: At equal generation counts (100 generations), the evolved memetic algorithm reached 11.423 bit/s/Hz at 1 W (7.6% over a conventional GA) and 23.611 bit/s/Hz at 5 W (8.2% over a conventional GA), and about 4 to 6% above the two LLM-assisted GA baselines.
caveat: Equal generations are not equal evaluation budgets, because local search adds evaluations, and error bars overlap with the LLM-GA baselines at some operating points. Results are simulated (10 users, one eavesdropper, 20x20 grid) in a preprint accepted by WCSP 2026.
beyond_harness_note: The LLM works only offline to design the search operators, and the deployed memetic algorithm needs no LLM queries.
generative_model: Pretrained LLM (DeepSeek Reasoner) inside the ReEvo reflective-evolution framework
algorithmic_authority: Wireless channel simulation with secure WMMSE beamforming scoring each port subset

sources.title: Beyond LLM-GA: Secure Fluid Antenna Systems with ReEvo-Designed Memetic Algorithm (arXiv:2610.10235)
ReEvo: Large Language Models as Hyper-Heuristics with Reflective Evolution

verification.notes: arXiv id 2610.10235 resolves to the claimed title; v1 7 Oct 2026, v2 26 Oct 2026; comment 'Accepted by WCSP 2026'. Read abstract and HTML full text. Report said 'higher secure sum-rate than plain GA and LLM-GA at equal generations': correct, and now quantified. The page cites ReEvo as NeurIPS 2024 (Ye et al.) but does not print arXiv 2402.01145; that link is only background. Affiliations are not shown on the page, so org is left generic.
